'''Area D-502''' was a quadrant of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Area D-502 was considered among the safest areas of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It served as the base of operations for both the [[O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild]] and the [[Aii`tkian Anthropologists]]. Both the Junk Dealers and the Anthropologists were friendly groups, always willing to lend a helpful hand.<ref name="SWG:AD502">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space_poi|Area D-502|Dantooine system}}</ref> The Aii`tkian scientists explored Area D-502 to collected rare [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipment that highlighted the existence of an ancient, space-faring [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Aii`tkian Anthropologists and the O.S.S. Junk Guild discovered a new strain of [[Copper/Legends|copper]] in the Dantooine system's Area D-502. Aii`tkian scientists then investigated whether it was worth to be used to manufacture [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

A [[RSF Outpost (Dantooine system)|RSF Outpost]] was located in Area D-502.<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Area D-502 was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AD502" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Area D-502 was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:AD502" />
